body:
{"operationName":"accountUser","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":""},"query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser(loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue) {
    ...AccountUserFragment
    __typename
  }
}

fragment AccountUserFragment on AccountUser {
  id
  firstName
  lastName
  email
  role
  encryptedUserId
  guestUserId
  customerNum
  loyaltyPlusValue
  loyaltyPlusDetails {
    tierName
    nextTier
    extCustomerId
    balance
    couponsCost
    isJCCCHolder
    coupons {
      ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      __typename
    }
    offers {
      ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  userDetails {
    anonUser
    passwordHint
    email
    userFirstName
    userLastName
    emailSignup
    countryCode
    fromCookie
    birthDate
    id
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
  id
  expiration
  displayName
  cost
  __typename
}

fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
  id
  displayName
  code
  expiration
  birthdayOffer
  offerType
  title
  header
  activeOn
  __typename
}
"}
